name: Cirrus AI Skills
description: AI agent skills for Cirrus HPC systems

skills.name: Slurm
skills.description: Submit, monitor, and manage HPC jobs using the Slurm workload manager on Cirrus systems. Includes guidance on resource allocation, job scripts, and safe polling intervals.

skills.name: Python
skills.description: Install and manage Python environments on Cirrus using Conda (Miniforge), uv, or Cray Python. Covers virtual environments, building aarch64 packages from source, compiler flags, mpi4py.

skills.name: Modules
skills.description: Use the modules system, Cray Programming Environments (PrgEnv-gnu, PrgEnv-cray, PrgEnv-intel, PrgEnv-aocc), compiler wrappers (cc, CC, ftn), compilers, and profiling tools (gprof, Cray perftools) on Cirrus.

skills.name: Spack
skills.description: Install, configure, and use Spack to build HPC software on Cirrus. Covers the Cirrus config, Spack environments, concretizing, installing

skills.name: Containers
skills.description: Run containers on Cirrus using Apptainer (formerly Singularity). Covers pulling, building, and migrating images, single-node and multi-node MPI workloads over Slingshot 11.

skills.name: MPI
skills.description: Use MPI on Cirrus with Cray MPICH, OpenMPI, or conda-installed MPI. Covers PrgEnv loading, PMI types (cray_shasta, pmi2, pmix), srun --mpi flags, libfabric and Slingshot 11 performance, and why mpirun/mpiexec must not be used.
